mainEntity.name: What is a Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit (JADU)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A JADU is a smaller ADU (max 500 sq ft) contained entirely within the existing walls of a single-family home, typically created by converting existing space like a bedroom or attached garage.
